#### List:

- PC
- PK
- PD

#### Physicochemical:

+------------------+----------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
|                  | **Unfractionated heparin (UFH)** | **Low molecular weight heparin (LMWH)** |
+==================+==================================+=========================================+
| MW               | 5-25kDa                          | \~4.5kDa                                |
+------------------+----------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
| Derivation       | Pig intestine                    | Same                                    |
|                  |                                  |                                         |
|                  | Cow lung                         |                                         |
+------------------+----------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+
| Aqueous solution | Y                                | Y                                       |
+------------------+----------------------------------+-----------------------------------------+

#### Pharmacokinetic:

+------------------------+---------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------+
|                        | **UFH**                                     | **LMWH**                                        |
+========================+=============================================+=================================================+
| Admin                  | - S/C bd prophylaxis                        | - S/C prophylaxis daily                         |
|                        | - IV infusion therapeutic                   | - S/C therapeutic 1mg/kg bd or 1.5mg/kg daily\  |
|                        |                                             |   (more convenient)                             |
+------------------------+---------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------+
| Time course            | - Onset IV \<5 min                          | - Peak: 2-4 hours                               |
|                        | - Onset S/C 2 hours                         | - Offset prophylactic: 12 hours                 |
|                        | - Offset therapeutic IV infusion: 6 hours   | - Offset therapeutic: 24 hours                  |
|                        |                                             |                                                 |
|                        |                                             | (↑ if renal impairment)                         |
+------------------------+---------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------+
| Absorption             | - Good subcut bioav                         | - Good subcut bioav                             |
+------------------------+---------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------+
| Distribution           | - V~D~ 0.1L/kg                              | - V~D~ 0.1L/kg                                  |
|                        | - Plasma protein binding \>95%              | - Plasma protein binding \>95% (almost all AT3) |
|                        |   - 1/3 AT3                                 | - Does cross placenta                           |
|                        |   - 2/3 other (albumin etc.)                |                                                 |
|                        | - Doesn’t cross placenta as much            |                                                 |
+------------------------+---------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------+
| Metabolism / excretion | - Variable rate                             | - Less variable rate                            |
|                        | - Zero order kinetics at high doses.        | - ?First order                                  |
|                        | - Heparinase: desulfation, depolymerisation | - Some by heparinase                            |
|                        | - Small amount urine unchanged              | - Most in urine unchanged                       |
|                        | - t~1/2~~β~ 90 mins                         | - t~1/2~~β~ \~5 hours                           |
|                        |                                             | - ↓Dose in renal impairment                     |
+------------------------+---------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------+

#### Pharmacodynamic:

+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                   | **UFH**                                                                 | **LMWH**                                                       |
+===================================+=========================================================================+================================================================+
| *Therapeutic:*                    |                                                                         |                                                                |
+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| MoA                               | - Binds AT3 → change shape\                                             | - Same                                                         |
|                                   |   (30% of heparins have a pentasaccharide sequence that binds AT3)      |                                                                |
+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| Factors inhibited                 | - II:X ratio = 1:1 (Only saccharides \>18 long can bridge AT3 and II)   | - IIa:Xa ratio = 1: 2-3                                        |
|                                   | - Also 11, 9, VIIa:TF complex                                           |                                                                |
+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| Platelet activation               | - Yes                                                                   | - Minimal                                                      |
+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| Reversibility with protamine      | - Near 100%                                                             | - \~60%                                                        |
|                                   | - Risk rebound anticoag as t~1/2~~β~ longer than protamines (90 cf. 60) | - Note risk re-bound anticoag as more is absorbed from S/C fat |
+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| Monitoring                        | - aPTT (titrate to 1.5-2.5x control)                                    | - FXa (less available)                                         |
|                                   | - Mandatory if infusion (↑variable response due to many binding sites)  | - Usually not needed (bound to AT3 only, less variable)        |
+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| *Side effects:*                   |                                                                         |                                                                |
+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| Heparin-induced thrombocytopaenia | - 1/200 therapeutic dose                                                | - ↓Risk                                                        |
|                                   | - 1/1000 prophylactic dose                                              |                                                                |
+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| Bleeding                          | - ↑Risk (1-5%)                                                          | - ↓Risk                                                        |
|                                   | - But can reverse                                                       | - But can’t fully reverse                                      |
+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| Other side effects                | - Deranged LFTs                                                         | - Similar to UFH but lower risk                                |
|                                   | - Osteoporosis                                                          |                                                                |
|                                   | - Skin necrosis                                                         |                                                                |
|                                   | - Alopecia                                                              |                                                                |
|                                   | - IV bolus: hypotension                                                 |                                                                |
+-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
